frame.name: Caster Frame
frame.description:
[Heavy Attack]  : Launch a heavy projectile attack.
Heavy attacks are stronger with full energy.

origins.name: Loss
origins.description: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and aim assist whenever your shields are broken or when a friendly Guardian is defeated. Effect lasts until you are defeated.

perks.name: Relentless Strikes
perks.description: [Light Attack]  : Landing three light-attack hits within a short time grants Sword ammo.

enhanced.name: Relentless Strikes
enhanced.description: [Light Attack]  : Landing three light-attack hits within an improved short time grants Sword ammo.

perks.name: Flash Counter
perks.description: Blocking damage after raising your guard emits a short-range blast that disorients targets.

enhanced.name: Flash Counter
enhanced.description: Blocking damage after raising your guard emits a short-range blast that disorients targets for an improved period of time.

perks.name: Eager Edge
perks.description: Gain increased Sword lunge distance immediately after switching to this weapon.

enhanced.name: Eager Edge
enhanced.description: Gain further increased Sword lunge distance immediately after switching to this weapon.

perks.name: Proximity Power
perks.description: When targets are nearby, final blows grant bonus Melee stat.

enhanced.name: Proximity Power
enhanced.description: When targets are nearby, final blows grant an improved amount of bonus Melee stat.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

enhanced.name: Demolitionist
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Rolling Storm
perks.description:
Final blows grant Bolt Charge.
While amplified, final blows grant additional Bolt Charge.

enhanced.name: Rolling Storm
enhanced.description:
Final blows grant Bolt Charge.
While amplified, final blows grant additional Bolt Charge. 
Gain increased Bolt Charge stacks when you have none.

perks.name: Assassin's Blade
perks.description: Sword final blows boost movement speed and damage.

enhanced.name: Assassin's Blade
enhanced.description: Sword final blows boost movement speed and damage for an improved duration.

perks.name: Whirlwind Blade
perks.description: Rapid sword strikes increase this weapon's damage for a short duration. Guarding also ends the effect.

enhanced.name: Whirlwind Blade
enhanced.description: Rapid Sword strikes increase this weapon's damage for an improved duration. Guarding ends the effect.

perks.name: Gear Shift
perks.description: Reloading after a final blow or becoming amplified grants a period of increased damage. Stacks 5x.

enhanced.name: Gear Shift
enhanced.description: Reloading after a final blow or becoming amplified grants a longer period of increased damage. Stacks 5x.

perks.name: Jolting Feedback
perks.description:
Dealing repeated damage with this weapon inflicts Jolt. 

While amplified, Jolt is applied faster.

enhanced.name: Jolting Feedback
enhanced.description:
Dealing repeated damage with this weapon inflicts Jolt at an increased rate. 

While amplified, Jolt is applied faster.

perks.name: Sword Logic
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.

enhanced.name: Sword Logic
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.

perks.name: Binary Orbit
perks.description: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for a short duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.

enhanced.name: Binary Orbit
enhanced.description: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for an improved duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Aggregate Charge
perks.description: This weapon deals more damage for each elemental debuff applied to the target.

enhanced.name: Aggregate Charge
enhanced.description: This weapon deals more damage for each elemental debuff applied to the target. Damage bonus is increased.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.description: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

enhanced.name: Elemental Honing
enhanced.description: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus for an improved duration. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.
